description: This file defines the 'Login' feature in the application, including data models, validation, and handler logic for user login functionality within the ASP.NET Core project. It handles user credential validation, token generation, and error handling related to user authentication.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data model representing user's email and password inputs for login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Record encapsulating the login command with user data, used as input for the login handler.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator using FluentValidation to ensure email and password are provided and not empty.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login process: verifies user credentials, generates a JWT token, and returns user data wrapped in a UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Login.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the login process: retrieves user by email, verifies password, generates token, and maps user data.
